affiliates.title: Affiliates
affiliates.body_html:
Earn money sharing tees you love

The Matcha-Tees affiliate programme pays you a commission for every sale you send our way. It's free to join and takes minutes to set up.

How it works

  1. Apply — email us (details below) and we'll set up your affiliate account.
  2. Share — you'll get a personal referral link and discount code to share on your socials, blog, or with friends.
  3. Earn — you earn 10% commission on every order placed through your link or code.

The details

  • 30-day tracking cookie — if someone clicks your link and buys within 30 days, you get the commission
  • Payouts monthly via PayPal or bank transfer, once your balance reaches £25
  • Commission is calculated on the order subtotal (excluding shipping and taxes), after any refunds
  • Self-referrals and coupon-site posting are not permitted
  • You must disclose your affiliate relationship in line with UK advertising rules (ASA/CAP guidance) — a simple "#ad" or "affiliate link" note is fine

Who it's for

Content creators, streamers, students, fan communities — anyone with an audience that loves great tees. No minimum follower count required.

Apply now

Email dharmasamuderamanunggal@gmail.com with the subject line "Affiliate application", including your name and the channels where you plan to share your link.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.body_html:
Last updated: 11 June 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Matcha-Tees ("we", "us") collects, uses and protects your personal data when you visit our store or place an order. We are based in Indonesia and sell to customers in the United Kingdom. Where we process the personal data of UK customers, we do so in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018, as well as applicable Indonesian data protection law (Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection).

1. Who we are

Matcha-Tees is operated from Indonesia. For any privacy question or request, contact us at dharmasamuderamanunggal@gmail.com.

2. What we collect

  • Order data: name, delivery address, email address, phone number, and details of what you bought. Payment card details are processed by our payment providers and never stored by us.
  • Account data: if you create an account — your login email and order history.
  • Technical data: IP address, browser and device information, and how you use our site, collected via cookies and similar technologies.
  • Marketing data: your email address and preferences if you sign up to our newsletter.

3. Why we use it (lawful bases)

  • To fulfil your order — processing, delivery, customs paperwork, and customer service (performance of a contract).
  • To meet legal obligations — tax, accounting and consumer law records.
  • To run and improve the store — analytics, fraud prevention, site security (legitimate interests).
  • To send marketing — only with your consent, which you can withdraw at any time via the unsubscribe link in any email.

4. Who we share it with

We share data only with service providers who need it to serve you: our e-commerce platform (Shopify), payment processors, print and fulfilment partners, delivery carriers, and email/analytics providers. We do not sell your personal data.

5. International transfers

Because we operate from Indonesia and use international service providers, your data may be transferred outside the UK. Where this happens, we rely on safeguards such as the providers' standard contractual protections and platform-level compliance (e.g. Shopify's data processing terms).

6. How long we keep it

Order and tax records are kept for as long as the law requires (typically 6–7 years). Marketing data is kept until you unsubscribe. Technical data is retained per our analytics providers' standard windows.

7. Cookies

We use essential cookies to make the store work (cart, checkout, login) and, with your consent, analytics and marketing cookies to understand how the site is used and to measure advertising. You can manage cookies through your browser settings or our cookie banner.

8. Your rights (UK customers)

Under UK GDPR you have the right to: access your data; correct it; delete it; restrict or object to processing; data portability; and withdraw consent at any time. To exercise any right, email us — we respond within one month. You also have the right to complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.

9. Children

Our store is not directed at children under 16 and we do not knowingly collect their data.

10. Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The "last updated" date at the top shows the current version.

return-policy.title: Return & Refund Policy
return-policy.body_html:
Last updated: 11 June 2026

We want you to love your Matcha-Tees order. If something isn't right, this policy explains how returns, exchanges and refunds work. Nothing in this policy affects your statutory rights as a UK consumer under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 and the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013.

1. Your 14-day right to cancel (UK customers)

As a UK consumer buying online, you have the legal right to cancel your order for any reason within 14 days of the day you receive your items, and a further 14 days to send the items back. To cancel, email us at dharmasamuderamanunggal@gmail.com with your order number and let us know you wish to cancel.

2. Our 30-day returns promise

On top of your legal rights, we accept returns for 30 days from delivery on any unworn, unwashed item in its original condition with any tags attached.

3. Faulty, damaged or wrong items

If your item arrives damaged, has a print defect, or isn't what you ordered, we will put it right at no cost to you — with a free replacement or a full refund, including original delivery charges. Please email us within 30 days of delivery with your order number and a couple of photos of the issue. In most cases you will not need to post the faulty item back to us.

4. Change of mind returns

Because our products are shipped internationally (we produce and dispatch from Indonesia), return postage for change-of-mind returns is paid by the customer. Before sending anything, please email us first — we'll confirm the correct return address and reference number. Items returned without prior contact may be delayed or lost.

5. Refunds

  • Refunds are issued to your original payment method.
  • We process refunds within 14 days of receiving the returned item (or, for faulty items, within 14 days of agreeing the refund).
  • For cancellations under your 14-day legal right, we refund the item price plus standard delivery. We may deduct an amount if the value of the goods has been reduced by handling beyond what is needed to inspect them.

6. Exchanges

Need a different size? Email us and we'll arrange an exchange where stock allows. For defective items the replacement is free; for change-of-mind size swaps we may ask you to cover the additional postage.

7. Items we can't accept back

  • Items that have been worn (beyond trying on), washed, or altered
  • Personalised or custom-printed items made to your specification, unless faulty
  • Items returned more than 30 days after delivery, unless faulty

8. How to start a return

  1. Email dharmasamuderamanunggal@gmail.com with your order number.
  2. Tell us what you'd like — refund, replacement or exchange — and include photos if the item is faulty.
  3. We'll reply within 2 business days with the next steps.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.body_html:
Last updated: 11 June 2026

All Matcha-Tees products are printed and dispatched from our facility in Indonesia and shipped to customers in the United Kingdom.

1. Processing time

Orders are printed to order. Please allow 2–5 business days for production before your order ships. You'll receive a dispatch email with tracking once it leaves our facility.

2. Delivery times to the UK

  • Standard tracked: typically 7–14 business days after dispatch
  • Express: typically 4–7 business days after dispatch

These are estimates, not guarantees — customs processing can occasionally add time.

3. Taxes and import charges

Prices are shown in pounds sterling (GBP). For orders of £135 or less, UK VAT is accounted for at checkout, so there should be nothing extra to pay on delivery. For orders over £135, import VAT (and duty where applicable) may be collected by the carrier before delivery — these charges are the customer's responsibility and will be clearly flagged at checkout.

4. Tracking

Every order ships with tracking. If your tracking hasn't updated for more than 10 business days, contact us and we'll investigate with the carrier.

5. Lost or undelivered orders

If your order hasn't arrived within 30 days of dispatch, email us at dharmasamuderamanunggal@gmail.com and we'll send a free replacement or issue a full refund. Please double-check your delivery address at checkout — we can't refund orders delivered to an incorrectly entered address, but we'll always try to help re-route them.

terms-and-conditions.title: Terms & Conditions
terms-and-conditions.body_html:
Last updated: 11 June 2026

These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the Matcha-Tees website and your purchases from us. By placing an order you agree to these Terms. Nothing in these Terms affects your statutory rights as a UK consumer.

1. About us

Matcha-Tees is operated from Indonesia and sells apparel and accessories to customers in the United Kingdom. Contact: dharmasamuderamanunggal@gmail.com.

2. Orders and contract formation

Your order is an offer to buy. A contract is formed when we email you confirmation that your order has been dispatched. We may decline or cancel an order before dispatch — for example where a product is unavailable, a pricing error occurred, or we suspect fraud — and will refund any payment taken.

3. Prices and payment

  • Prices are shown in pounds sterling (GBP) and include UK VAT where applicable on consignments of £135 or less.
  • For orders over £135, import VAT and any duty may be payable by you on delivery — see our Shipping Policy.
  • Delivery charges are shown at checkout before you pay.
  • If we discover an obvious pricing error, we will contact you to confirm or cancel the order at the correct price.

4. Products

Our products are printed to order. Colours may vary slightly from what you see on screen due to display settings and the printing process; minor variation is not a defect. Size guides are provided on product pages — please check before ordering.

5. Delivery

We dispatch from Indonesia with tracked international shipping. Estimated delivery times are set out in our Shipping Policy. Risk in the goods passes to you on delivery; ownership passes when we receive payment in full.

6. Cancellations, returns and refunds

UK consumers have a 14-day right to cancel under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013, and remedies for faulty goods under the Consumer Rights Act 2015. Our full process, including our extended 30-day returns promise, is in our Return & Refund Policy.

7. Intellectual property

All designs, artwork, images, text and branding on this site are owned by or licensed to Matcha-Tees. You may not reproduce, resell or commercially exploit any content without our written permission. If you believe any content infringes your rights, contact us and we will investigate promptly.

8. Acceptable use

You agree not to misuse the site — including attempting unauthorised access, scraping at scale, placing fraudulent orders, or uploading malicious content.

9. Our liability

We do not exclude or limit liability where it would be unlawful to do so, including for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or your statutory consumer rights. Subject to that, our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for that order, and we are not liable for indirect losses such as loss of profit.

10. Events outside our control

We are not responsible for delay or failure caused by events beyond our reasonable control (e.g. carrier disruption, customs delays, natural disasters). If a delay is substantial, you may cancel undelivered orders for a full refund.

11. Complaints and disputes

If something goes wrong, email us first — we aim to resolve all complaints within 14 days. As we sell to consumers in the UK, you benefit from mandatory UK consumer protections. These Terms are otherwise governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia, and UK consumers retain the right to bring proceedings in their local courts where applicable law allows.

12. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. The version in force when you place your order applies to that order.

wholesale.title: Wholesale
wholesale.body_html:
Stock Matcha-Tees in your store

We partner with retailers, boutiques and online stores in the UK who want to carry our designs. Because we produce in Indonesia, we can offer competitive bulk pricing with full customisation options.

What we offer

  • Tiered pricing — discounts scale with order volume, starting at 25 units per design
  • Mixed-size cartons — choose your own size curve per design
  • Custom labelling — relabelling and custom neck prints available on larger orders
  • Direct UK delivery — consolidated bulk shipping to your premises, with all import paperwork handled

Minimums and lead times

  • Minimum order: 25 units per design, 100 units per order
  • Production lead time: 2–3 weeks from confirmed order
  • Shipping to the UK: 1–2 weeks (express options available)

How to apply

Email dharmasamuderamanunggal@gmail.com with the subject line "Wholesale enquiry" and include:

  1. Your business name and website or social profiles
  2. Where you sell (physical shop, online, marketplace)
  3. The designs or product types you're interested in
  4. Estimated order volume

We respond to all wholesale enquiries within 2 business days.
